initialization: same task-family Evo2 LoRA adapter used by DNA_TTO
policy: Evo2 causal ACGT logits define a prompt-conditioned parallel edit policy
sequence_filter_policy: ACGT-only and fixed length; GC and homopolymer rejection disabled
evaluation_boundary: independent metrics are computed only after immutable Top-256 locks
analysis_unit: seed; mean and sample SD over three paired seeds
ppo_note: terminal-reward clipped PPO with a prompt-conditioned moving reward baseline
grpo_note: terminal-reward clipped GRPO with within-start group-standardized advantages and no critic
